## a) Distribution Studying
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
boxplot(Sepal.Length ~ Species, main = "Sepal Length vs. Species")
boxplot(Sepal.Width ~ Species, main = "Sepal Width vs. Species")
boxplot(Petal.Length ~ Species, main = "Petal Length vs. Species")
boxplot(Petal.Width ~ Species, main = "Petal Width vs. Species")
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```
<discussion here>

## b) QQ Plots for investigation
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

# Loop through each unique species
for (sp in levels(Species)) {
  subset_data <- subset(iris, Species == sp)
  qqnorm(subset_data$Petal.Width, main = paste("Q-Q Plot (against petal width):", sp))
  qqline(subset_data$Petal.Width, col = "red")
}

# Reset layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
